## seo-audit-skill v2.0.0 Changelog

- Removed PageSpeed checks and dependencies from the basic audit (scripts/check-pagespeed.py and related logic eliminated)
- Updated report template and report instructions to match the new, simplified check scope
- Clarified scope: Only the allowed checks in the updated template are permitted (no Core Web Vitals, PageSpeed, or other advanced checks)
- Documentation and references updated to reflect the leaner, strictly basic audit process

Initial release – basic on-page SEO audit skill

- New scripts added for single-page audits: check-site.py, check-page.py, check-schema.py, fetch-page.py.
- Outputs structured HTML audit reports using a predefined template; saves to file system (never prints HTML raw).
- Performs core checks only: site-level, E-E-A-T trust pages, and allowed page-level SEO items (title, H1, meta, schema, etc.).
- Strictly lightweight scope—no advanced, technical, or social/OG checks (refer users to seo-audit-full for deep audits).
- All results are based strictly on script JSON output and report template; no extra checks or improvisation permitted.
